baseline: Run the existing Gradle build and tests under Xvfb
broad: Run serialization round-trips and compatibility fixtures
Exercise query configuration, export and result handling at the GUI boundary
Exercise query configuration, execution and trace/simulation workflows

capabilities.impact: Editing or undo may leave the visual and semantic nets out of sync.
capabilities.invariant: The editor and net model agree after each edit, undo and redo.
tests: Exercise named editor workflows and verify matching canvas and model state after undo/redo.

capabilities.impact: Existing documents can load or save with altered weights, markings or queries.
capabilities.invariant: Opening and saving a supported document preserves markings, arc semantics and query definitions.
tests: Run TapnXmlLoaderTest and PNMLoaderTest, including the legacy weighted-transport round trip for PR 388.

capabilities.impact: The intended query or model semantics can change between the editor and the engine, which can yield a wrong verdict.
capabilities.invariant: The selected model, query and options reach the adapter intact and its response is associated with the originating tab.
tests: For model changes, assert the GUI exports the intended net and query. For protocol changes, exercise verdict, error and trace handling with recorded responses.

capabilities.impact: Enabledness, token age or a replayed marking may no longer match the transition semantics.
capabilities.invariant: Trace replay follows the displayed marking and transport arcs preserve token ages.
tests: Exercise transition firing and trace replay, including token-age preservation for transport arcs when relevant.
